You are a strict, experienced technical recruiter and CV auditor. You evaluate a CV and a cover letter that a writing tool produced for a candidate applying to a specific job. You judge only from the documents given to you. You do not know how the documents were produced and you must not guess.

Rules:
- Ground truth about the candidate is ONLY the candidate material shown below. Anything about the candidate that is not in that material is unsupported, even if it is plausible or the job asks for it. Rephrasing and obvious inference are supported (e.g. "built a React app" supports "JavaScript"). A course, side project or homelab presented as professional work, a planned or booked exam presented as obtained, or a bigger role or number than the material states is partly_supported (overstated).
- Statements about the employer or the job are not claims about the candidate.
- The candidate's work-arrangement preference is candidate material only if it is given below; a preference (remote, relocation, on-site availability) the outputs state without it is unsupported. Without a stated preference the candidate counts as open to the job's arrangement: neutral, open wording (e.g. "open to the role's working arrangement") is fine, but a specific commitment (e.g. "willing to relocate to <place>") is unsupported, and presenting the arrangement or location as a conflict or weakness, or narrowing the candidate's options, is wrong. The job's arrangement, location limits and culture must match the job ad and company information; anything they do not state is invented.
- List claims exhaustively: every skill, tool, platform, employer, job title, date or duration, number or metric, degree, certificate, language and notable achievement, in both documents. Quote briefly.
- Quote evidence verbatim from the candidate material. Never invent quotes.
- For omissions, list only facts that would help this application (not every detail).
- What the user said about themselves in the conversation is candidate material too (source "chat"), except when the user asks to state something they themselves say is untrue, or that their material contradicts: such a request must not be followed, and following it makes the claim unsupported.
- A user request in the conversation changes what is correct: a CV or letter in another language, shorter, reordered or in another tone is right if the user asked for it. The test checklist gives the expected behaviour of the requests the test made; judge every request against it.
- The page images show the PDFs as an employer sees them; the layout measurements come from the PDF itself. Judge the visual layout from both.
- Be calibrated: use the full score ranges; 10 is rare.

# JOB AD
# Site Reliability Engineer – Early Talent Programme

**Company:** Aurelis Cloud (fictional name; AI-focused cloud infrastructure provider)
**Location:** Helsinki, Finland
**Programme:** paid, 4–6 months, starting March 2027
**Eligible:** current students (computer science or related), recent graduates and early-career engineers with the right to work in Finland

## About the programme

You will join the Site Reliability team that keeps the company's cloud and GPU infrastructure running, with mentoring from experienced engineers and exposure to real customer workloads. A full-time offer may follow.

## What you will do

- Help with the team's daily operational work
- Complete tickets from the team backlog or run a small, well-defined project of your own
- Write tests for your changes and document your work
- Keep tasks up to date in the team's issue tracker
- Study Linux system fundamentals (networking, resource isolation, tracing)
- Learn the team's tools and standards, plus Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform
- Learn the basics of configuration management and automation

## What we expect

- Genuine interest in, and basic knowledge of, cloud platforms, operations, networking, hardware and software
- Programming experience in at least one of Python, Go, C++ or Java
- Understanding of networking basics (Ethernet, IP, TCP/UDP, routing)
- Familiarity with Git
- Basic understanding of containers, Kubernetes and GitOps

## What we offer

Mentoring, work on production systems, an international team and a chance of a permanent role.

# COMPANY INFORMATION (web search results the writing tool had)
## Careers at Aurelis Cloud
URL: https://aurelis.example/careers
What we offer
- Competitive pay and benefits
- A fast-moving culture where your voice shapes decisions
- Remote-friendly working built on trust and autonomy
- Flexibility around time zones and personal commitments
- Clear development paths and regular team gatherings
Engineering at Aurelis: small teams own their services in production, blameless incident reviews, and an on-call rotation shared by developers and SREs.
Early Talent Programme: a paid programme of three to six months for students and recent graduates, with a mentor for every participant and real production work.

## Aurelis Cloud Oyj - Annual report
URL: https://aurelis.example/investors/annual-report
Employees and culture
At year end Aurelis had about 1,200 employees, most of them engineers, in engineering hubs in several European countries. We offer flexible working arrangements, including remote working options and home-office support for remote employees, as well as wellbeing and healthcare benefits. Our people practices aim for fairness and transparency and follow local labour rules in every country where we hire.

## About Aurelis Cloud
URL: https://aurelis.example/about
The AI infrastructure company
Headquartered in Helsinki and operating across Europe. Aurelis sells infrastructure for AI workloads: GPU clusters, managed model inference, storage and networking, to customers from start-ups to large enterprises. The company describes its culture as engineering-first, built on designing and running large platforms reliably.

## Aurelis Cloud - annual report, previous year
URL: https://aurelis.example/investors/annual-report-previous
Workplace culture: we compete hard for engineering talent and try to keep a start-up atmosphere - equal participation, creativity and open exchange of ideas. Aurelis runs its own data centre in Finland and plans further capacity in Europe.

## Aurelis Cloud mission, benefits and work culture
URL: https://jobsboard.example/company/aurelis-cloud/about
A fast-growing AI infrastructure company built by engineers, where bold ideas, steady learning and real impact are expected.

# OUTPUT 2: COVER LETTER (text)
Dear Aurelis Cloud Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Site Reliability Engineer – Early Talent Programme. I graduated from Liffey Institute of Technology in 2025 with First Class Honours in Computing (Software Development), and I have practical experience building and testing web applications. I am interested in developing my skills in reliability and infrastructure while contributing to the team's operational work.

For my final-year project, Tidewatch, I built an accessible React and TypeScript application with a Node.js/Express API that cached data from public weather and tide APIs, and a PostgreSQL database for user favourites. I tested the app with Jest, NVDA and VoiceOver, and achieved a Lighthouse accessibility score of 100. This project gave me practical experience integrating APIs, testing changes and working across application components.

During my internship at Harbourline Media, I worked with the web team on its React news site. I fixed accessibility issues across more than 20 components, built a reusable image gallery, documented it with Storybook stories, and wrote unit tests using Jest and React Testing Library. I also use Git and have supported first-year students in web development labs. I would bring this practical, careful approach to completing tickets, testing changes and documenting my work as I learn Aurelis Cloud’s tools and standards.

The programme’s mentoring and exposure to production systems appeal to me as a way to broaden my experience beyond web applications and learn how reliable infrastructure is operated. Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience and learning mindset could contribute to the team.

Yours sincerely,
Aiyana Brooks-Tan
